name: APIs.guru OpenAPI directory
tier_rationale: Long-running open-source community directory with an identifiable maintainer team and a public repository (A8 community); P069 chair rationale: 'Tier community for APIs.guru'.

reliability.justification: Community-curated directory of public OpenAPI definitions: entries are real public API descriptions, but the directory has been frozen since 2023-04 (newest 'updated' date seen 2026-11-26), so hits are old and coverage is partial.

directory.title: APIs.guru directory: v2/list.json (every provider, API version and spec URL) and v2/metrics.json, downloaded daily and matched locally
directory.notes: Quote: research record C0179 terms (verified_live 200). list.json is 8.86 MB (> 5 MB: large, `v3lum data update public_api_exposure.apisguru_list` only, never mid-scan, A6 BR9 / AR10); a conditional GET answers 304 (ETag + Last-Modified). metrics.json (about 1 KB) is the small companion dataset public_api_exposure.apisguru_metrics (entry-count cross-check). The per-provider spec files are never requested: matching is local, so the target never reaches APIs.guru (P069 cond 1). Contact names and e-mails inside the directory are never read. Used by public_api_exposure.
